    ((date('2024-01-01') - date(birth_date)) / 365) AS age

  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM user_ages
GROUP BY age_category

  CASE age_category
    WHEN '20s' THEN 1
    WHEN '30s' THEN 2

        WHEN (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 >= 30 AND (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 < 40 THEN '30s'
        WHEN (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 >= 40 AND (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 < 50 THEN '40s'
        WHEN (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 >= 50 AND (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 < 60 THEN '50s'
        ELSE 'others'
    END AS age_category,
    COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM user_ages u
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY 
    CASE age_category 
        WHEN '20s' THEN 1
        WHEN '30s' THEN 2
        WHEN '40s' THEN 3
